reasoning_summary: シオン (bmd_1x) consistently pushed for evidence-based decisions and protection of information roles (refs L100, L114, L121). They prevented an immediate, unsubstantiated lynch by demanding concrete quoted reasons from the proponents and by publicly challenging the rapid vote alignment (refs L107, L121). This behavior matched villager goals (protect seer/medium, avoid mislynch) and was role-consistent. However, they did not propose alternate suspects or concrete positive leads and did not successfully convert their caution into a vote coalition; they were executed on Day 2 (L131) before recovering influence. Overall: constructive and faction-aligned but limited in vote-shaping effectiveness.
strengths: Demanded concrete evidence and citation before endorsing a lynch (refs L100, L114, L121).
Prioritized preservation and use of information roles (supported protection of Victoria and Mizuki; refs L100, L114).
Called out suspicious rapid vote alignment and asked proponents to explain specific quoted lines (refs L107, L121), which is useful for exposing wolf coordination.
weaknesses: Did not offer alternative actionable targets or lead a vote convergence after pushing to stop the flow (no clear candidate proposed after L100–L121).
Limited vote formation impact—failed to convert caution into a controlling voting block; was executed on Day 2 (L131).
Relatively low proactive evidence production despite claiming observational strength (self-intro L19 remained the main cited line against them).

reasoning_summary: Minato executed a disciplined wolf plan: he used private coordination with bmd_7x (ジョージ) to set roles and nightly targets (whispers L10–L13, L36–L43), publicly seeded soft suspicion (e.g. L59, L97) and then pressed for concrete-sourcing to drive votes (L111, L118), which contributed to the daytime execution of Shion (L131) and allowed wolf night actions (attack votes L85/L134/L169 and attacks L86/L135/L170). strengths: Clear private coordination with teammate(s) and adherence to the planned division of labor (whispers L10–L13, L36–L43).

weaknesses: Public arguments frequently relied on generic village-empathy and calls for caution rather than unique investigative claims; this limited the ability to create incontrovertible evidence when needed (many 'protect the seer' / 'wait for proof' lines: L146–L156).
When the seer targeted him (divination L168), public posture did not provide an effective contingency to deflect or re-route suspicion, so he was exposed and executed late (L195).

Some public behavior (repeatedly urging protection of information sources) risked being counterproductive if overused, since it can look village-aligned and reduce cover for wolves if villagers begin to trust roles (e.g. consistent calls to guard Victoria: L146–L157).
